_comment: Intentional Latin text in web/src/**/*.tsx that tests/no-literals.test.ts accepts outside t(). 'terms' are words that stay in Latin script in every language (brands, formats, units); 'texts' are whole literals kept on purpose (code identifiers, file names, scope names shown as code). Tokens with an underscore, a dot or a slash (refund_inr, docs/SCOPE.md, shpat_) count as code and are always accepted.
